objective: Translate curated field/environment evidence into a bounded ASC prompt without closing unsupported spatial, ecological, taxonomic, gameplay, artistic, or execution decisions.
structuralContract: Preserve provenance from field evidence to ASC prompt.
Preserve separation between observed evidence, interpretation, contract, execution, and result.
Do not convert environmental photographs into map topology or species placement rules.
Do not treat generated output as evidence automatically.
mandatoryRelations: FIELD-ARR-2026-09-16-01 supplies environmental evidence only where directly documented.
ASC produces an ASC prompt; an external executor produces any generative result.
Unsupported spatial, taxonomic, ecological, gameplay, artistic, and provider decisions remain OPEN.
open: Exact mapping of field photographs to versioned environment manifest records.
Exact field coordinates, altitude, bearing, and orientation where not recorded.
Approved final art direction for this scene.
doNotInfer: Do not infer species identity from visual resemblance alone.
Do not infer ecological placement from a generic environmental photograph.
Do not infer map topology from perspective photographs.
Do not infer exact camera metadata when it is absent.
Do not infer an ecological rule from a single reference.
Do not select a generative provider by plausibility or convenience.
prohibited: Do not present a generated image as automatic ecological or botanical evidence.
Do not silently promote interpretedNotes into observed facts.
Do not use comparative references as sole authority for the appearance of the territory core.
Do not modify the botanical master through this adapter.
validationCriteria: The contract passes ASC v0.1 structural validation.
The same contract produces exactly the same compiled prompt.
All unsupported decisions remain explicitly OPEN.
No unauthorized top-level ASC fields are introduced.
A negative test with an unauthorized field fails closed.
